name: Dimensional Obsessive-Compulsive Scale (DOCS)
directions: Think about the past month. Rate each concern from 0 (no symptoms) to 4 (extreme symptoms).

questions.text: How much time is occupied by contamination thoughts and washing or cleaning behaviors?
How much do you avoid situations to prevent contamination concerns or having to wash or clean?
If you had contamination thoughts but could not wash, clean, or remove the contamination, how distressed or anxious would you become?
How much do contamination concerns interfere with your daily routine, work, school, self-care, or social life?
How difficult is it to disregard contamination thoughts and refrain from washing, cleaning, or other rituals?
How much time is occupied by thoughts about possible harm or disasters and checking or other rituals?
How much do you avoid situations to avoid checking for danger or worrying about possible harm?
When you think about possible harm or cannot check or get reassurance, how distressed or anxious do you become?
How much do harm concerns disrupt your daily routine, work, school, self-care, or social life?
How difficult is it to disregard possible-harm thoughts and refrain from checking or reassurance seeking?
How much time is occupied by unwanted unpleasant thoughts and behavioral or mental rituals?
How much do you avoid situations, places, objects, or reminders that bring these thoughts to mind?
When unwanted thoughts come to mind against your will, how distressed or anxious do you become?
How much do unwanted thoughts disrupt your daily routine, work, school, self-care, or social life?
How difficult is it to disregard unwanted thoughts and refrain from behavioral or mental rituals?
How much time is occupied by thoughts about symmetry, order, or balance and arranging or repeating behaviors?
How much do you avoid situations or objects associated with things feeling not quite right?
When things feel not quite right, how distressed or anxious do you become?
How much do these concerns disrupt your daily routine, work, school, self-care, or social life?
How difficult is it to disregard symmetry or order thoughts and refrain from arranging or repeating?
